system.description:
System Points 1

The entire ship is rigged with a full security system, including cameras, motion sensors, security doors, and alarms. Also includes automated weapon systems.

Intruders attempting to break into the ship must make a Reaction Roll against a Difficulty of 12 + Tier. On a failure, they cannot enter the ship and also suffer physical damage from the automated defenses, taking d10 damage per tier.
